_note: Community and official pages per town. Every URL here was read off the organisation's own website, not guessed from a name pattern. `covers` lists the locality slugs an entry legitimately serves, because one council page serves a whole LGA and duplicating it per suburb would be noise. Add entries by fetching the organisation's own site and taking the URL from its footer. Never construct a Facebook URL from a name.
